args.content:
Hawaii Packing List

Destination: Hawaii
Dates: June 10th - June 20th, 2024

Packing List:
- Swimwear
- Sunscreen
- Hiking gear
- Casual outfits
- Camera
- Travel documents
- Beach towel
- Lightweight clothing for daytime
- Rain gear (light jacket or umbrella)
- Insect repellent
- First aid kit
- Power adapter (U.S. plug)
- Phone charger
- Snacks and energy bars
- Water bottles
- Sunglasses
- Swim cap
- Underwear and socks (multiple pairs)
- Toiletries (toothbrush, toothpaste, shampoo, etc.)
- Laundry bag for clothes
- Travel insurance documents
- Local currency (Hawaiian dollars)
- Books or entertainment (for downtime)
- Camera batteries and extra memory cards
- Waterproof phone case (for beach activities)
- Snorkeling gear (if planning to snorkel)
- Hiking boots (if planning to hike)
- Sun hat
- Umbrella or compact raincoat
- Medications (prescription and over-the-counter)
- Baby wipes (if traveling with children)
- Reusable shopping bags
- Personal items (sunglasses, jewelry, etc.)

Note: This packing list is based on the activities planned during the vacation, including beach days, snorkeling, hiking, and cultural experiences.
